 CAN 2027: Without a point, Sierra Leone calls up Malachi Jones against the DRC
 At the bottom of Group E after two defeats, Sierra Leone has called up 25 players to face the DRC on November 12 and 17. New York City FC player Malachi Jones is making his debut with the national team.

Français (Bénin) 
 The coach of Sierra Leone, Didier Gomes Da Rosa, has selected 25 players for the double confrontation against the Democratic Republic of Congo on November 12 and 17 in the qualifiers for CAN 2027. Among those called up is Malachi Jones, a forward from New York City FC, who has been summoned for the first time with the Leone Stars.
 Sierra Leone approaches these third and fourth matchdays at the bottom of Group E, without any points after two defeats. The DRC leads the group with six points, ahead of Zimbabwe and Equatorial Guinea, who each have three points.
 In his offensive sector, Gomes Da Rosa has also called up Augustus Kargbo (Blackburn Rovers), Sullay Kaikai (Cambridge United), Alhassan Koroma (Baniyas), Daniel Kanu (Notts County), Idris Kanu (Barnet), and Alie Conteh (Inter Turku). The defender Abdulai Juma Bah, who plays for Augsburg, as well as midfielder Tyrese Fornah, are also included on the list.
 A trip to Kinshasa before a relocated match in Morocco
 The Sierra Leoneans will first travel to Kinshasa, where the first leg is scheduled for Thursday, November 12, at the Stade des Martyrs. They will then host the Leopards on Tuesday, November 17, in Morocco, as their national stadium is not approved to host this international match.
 In the first two matchdays, the Leone Stars lost to Zimbabwe (2-3) and then to Equatorial Guinea (0-1). The Congolese, for their part, won their first two qualifying matches.
 The squad announced on November 6 includes three goalkeepers, Mamadou Jalloh, Francis Koroma, and Ibrahim Sesay. In defense, Osman Kakay, Emmanuel Samadia, Alpha Turay, Sallieu Tarawallie, MJ Kamson-Kamara, and Mohamed Fofanah accompany Juma Bah.
